summary: Legacy Authored decks missing V3 evidence may export in either public mode with a blocked public quality receipt; a present but blocked or digest-invalid receipt remains blocked in every mode.
invariants: Compatibility applies only when qualityReceiptV3 is entirely absent; the requested output mode no longer decides it.
The public QualityReceiptV3 remains releaseReadiness blocked and records missing checker evidence, for Hybrid exactly as for Fidelity.
The visual-review-pending allowance stays Fidelity-only: a sealed receipt whose sole blocker is human visual review never authorizes Hybrid.
forbidden: Do not bypass a present but blocked or digest-invalid V3 receipt, in any mode.
Do not treat compatibility export as release, promotion, or deployment readiness.
rationale: Revision 1 restricted compatibility to Fidelity because a public Hybrid export did not exist. `public-export.hybrid-in-isolated-lane` (authority user, 2026-09-04) created it, and leaving the restriction in place would make every deck predating the V3 receipt permanently raster-only.

The compatibility receipt already reports authoring and geometry evidence as failed/missing with releaseReadiness blocked. Delivering an editable file under that same honest receipt overstates nothing: it stops gating editability on evidence that does not gate raster delivery either.
